cases.prompt: Here's the storybook workspace we generated from the design zip — turn it into an implementation plan
expect: invokes the funcspec skill (full pipeline)
runs Phase 0 inventory before any analysis
conducts Stage-1 AskUserQuestion interview before evaluating pages
launches page-evaluator agents (composites first, then ALL pages in one simultaneous fan-out)
conducts Stage-2 validation interview before writing deliverables
drafts the four documents via parallel deliverable-writer agents, traceability main-thread
runs the cross-document consistency check before the closing summary
writes all five deliverables to docs/funcspec/

cases.prompt: Go through the pages in ./foundry-workspace and figure out what functionality the UI implies
expect: invokes funcspec in evaluate mode (Phases 0-4)
produces schema-valid page profiles in docs/funcspec/profiles/
produces synthesis.json with feature inventory and ambiguity register
does NOT generate the plan deliverables without the Stage-2 interview
ends by pointing to /bespoke-agentics:funcspec-plan

cases.setup: workspace contains an analysis.json produced by design-zip-to-library
expect: detects analysis.json and uses screens + component inventory as the page list
page-inventory.json has fast_path: true
does not re-derive the page list from story globs

cases.setup: an arbitrary Storybook repo with no analysis.json
expect: falls back to story-glob scanning
classifies Pages/ and fullscreen stories as pages, shell-like stories as composites
confirms the inventory with the user before evaluating

cases.setup: no browser tool available or storybook fails to boot
expect: skips visual verification with a one-line note instead of failing
profiles keep visual_verified: false
pipeline continues to synthesis

cases.prompt: evaluate this single page with an icon-only trash button and no confirmation dialog
expect: page-evaluator records a delete operation with an ambiguities entry (soft vs hard delete)
does not silently pick a reading
ambiguity question is phrased so it can be asked verbatim in Stage-2

cases.setup: synthesis contains one blocking ambiguity, user defers it in Stage-2
expect: ambiguity lands 🔴 in gap-register.md
affected plan section is labeled BLOCKED — needs decision
closing summary calls the plan a draft
every story in backlog.md has a Traces: line with page/affordance or operation ids
traceability.md orphan-check appendix is generated
verification pass runs before the closing summary and reports honestly
offers to push epics/stories to Jira and the plan to Confluence
does not create any Jira/Confluence artifact without explicit confirmation
files are written regardless of the push decision
reads inventory/profiles/synthesis and reports counts, ambiguity breakdown, deliverable checklist
suggests the correct next command
writes nothing
